kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتياسر (form VI)
# نَتَيَاسَرُ (natayāsaru) /na.ta.jaː.sa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# نُتَيَاسَرُ (nutayāsaru) /nu.ta.jaː.sa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# نَتَيَاسَرَ (natayāsara) /na.ta.jaː.sa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# نُتَيَاسَرَ (nutayāsara) /nu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
